notes: Read all three units, all eleven candidates and the review. Removed the two general prerequisite candidates because the following unselected mechanism claims already preserve the same labor-organizing and power-shift purposes without general-and-list repetition. Identified DSA in the historical self-critique, resolved the unjust laws as sex-work criminalization laws and the harm as DSA's failure to provide solidarity. Restored the omitted assertion that sex workers are often spoken over but rarely heard and the explicit call for socialist organizational accountability.

claims.claim_text: Sex workers are often spoken over but rarely listened to.
Socialists must hold their organizations accountable for past failures toward sex workers.
DSA remained silent when sex workers sought its solidarity against sex-work criminalization laws.
By adopting Resolution 53, Pro-Decriminalization of Sex Work, at its 2019 National Convention, DSA committed to begin remedying its failure to provide solidarity to sex workers.
